annotations.title: Run prompts and collect AI responses

description: Run tracked prompts against external AI providers to collect new responses for a website. Sends prompt text to the selected providers, stores their responses in AthenaHQ, and consumes response credits. Starts immediately; use only for a user-requested run. Returns a workflow_id; poll get_response_streaming_status over MCP or GET /api/v1/response-streaming/status over the API for progress.

prompt_ids.description: Specific tracked prompt UUIDs to run, from 1 to 1,000. Overrides schedule prompt selectors when supplied. Omit to use schedule_id selectors, or every active prompt when schedule_id is also omitted. Paused prompts are skipped.

schedule_id.description: Schedule UUID to attribute this run to and take prompt selectors from. A nonempty prompt_ids selection overrides those selectors. Omit to attribute the run to Default and run every active prompt unless prompt_ids is supplied. Explicit model, fan-out, persona and location choices apply to this run.

selected_models.description: Map of model id to enabled flag, e.g. { "chatgpt": true, "ai_overview": true, "ai_mode": false }. Model ids: chatgpt, ai_overview (Google AI Overviews; google_ai_overview is also accepted), perplexity, gemini, copilot, ai_mode, grok, claude, deepseek, meta_ai, mistral. An id set to true that names no model is rejected. Omit to run all enabled models.

name: start_response_streaming
